fingerprint_summary: Annual 'Petition & Notice of Foreclosure' published as a PDF on the WordPress county Treasurer page. The 2025 petition is a scanned, CCITT-fax-encoded image PDF (~2.7 MB) with no text layer — OCR required.
recommended_adapter: pdf_ocr_static_list (download annual petition PDF, OCR, parse parcel rows)
known_limitations: Annual publication cadence only — no rolling/searchable delinquent-tax list is published online
2025 petition PDF is scanned (CCITT fax) — OCR required to read SBL, owner, address, amount, redemption date
Treasurer publishes only the annual petition, not interim delinquency
